title: Very small
text: Very small. This towel is so small, it feels more like a large face washcloth. It is made from soft thread and I like the third layer. That was unique. But goodness, there is an unusably high amount of care instructions for a towel. Not to mention, the price. I would have felt ripped off had I paid full price. I wouldn't purchase this again, so I can't recommend it.
